about: Where each hand-checked pin's reporting comes from: who gave the statement, the spokesperson, the outlets, and whether the reports are independent of each other. Written after reading every source article (saved text, 19 Oct 2026) with the counterintel independence check as a first pass. Public: shown in the event drawer. Kept apart from the pin files so their fingerprints do not change. The private coding (reporters, motive, victims, arrests) is not in this file.

independence_values.single_report: One report only. Nothing to check it against.
independence_values.same_outlet: More than one report, all from one outlet. Not independent.
independence_values.same_statement: Several outlets, all resting on police statements. Not independent of the police account.
independence_values.shared_wording: Several outlets, but one repeats the other's wording. Counts as one account.
independence_values.partly_independent: Several outlets; most facts come from police, and at least one report adds its own non-police source.

048440e0-0be5-53d8-934a-1ba6233a0dfa.note: One police statement, three reports. Repetition is not independent corroboration. The mayor's post speaks to the chase, arrests and weapons, not the killing.
